title: An unpack into an empty directory whose write fails after it has written a file reports output.destination.write_failed, listing the file, and leaves it
notes: Its package.metais is written by internal/vectorgen (go test ./internal/vectorgen -run TestPackages -args -update), whose test reproduces the committed bytes. It is packed from the source directory aut/unpack/expected/src. Unpack writes inputs/report.schema.json, of 228 bytes, and then metais.yaml, of 394, which the setup's file-size limit of 300 bytes refuses (ADR-011 A6 item 3).
